className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

src.en-US: Address of the image to crop.

imgProps.zh-CN: 传给被裁切图片 `img` 标签的属性。`src` 由 `src` 属性决定；`className` 与组件自身的类名合并；`style` 位于组件布局之下，宽高与位移以组件为准；`onLoad` 在组件处理完成后调用；`alt` 默认为空字符串，`crossOrigin` 默认为 `anonymous`，均可覆盖。
imgProps.en-US: Attributes passed to the `img` element being cropped. `src` comes from the `src` prop; `className` is merged with the component's own class name; `style` sits under the component's layout, so the size and offset win; `onLoad` is called after the component has handled the load; `alt` defaults to an empty string and `crossOrigin` to `anonymous`, and both can be overridden.

shape.zh-CN: 裁切框形状，可选 `rect`、`round` 或 `roundRect`。
shape.en-US: Shape of the crop box: `rect`, `round` or `roundRect`.

aspectRatio.zh-CN: 固定的裁切框宽高比，拖动时保持该比例；加载后改变时，裁切框按新比例重排。
aspectRatio.en-US: Fixed aspect ratio of the crop box, kept while dragging. When it changes after loading, the box is laid out again at the new ratio.

defaultAspectRatio.zh-CN: 裁切框的初始宽高比，拖动时会随之变化。
defaultAspectRatio.en-US: Initial aspect ratio of the crop box, which changes while dragging.

zoom.zh-CN: 受控的缩放比例，叠加在图片适应裁切区域的初始缩放之上。
zoom.en-US: Controlled zoom, applied on top of the initial scaling that fits the image into the cropper.

onZoomChange.zh-CN: 滚轮缩放时触发，参数为新的缩放比例。
onZoomChange.en-US: Called with the new zoom when the wheel changes it.

rotate.zh-CN: 图片旋转角度，单位为度。单向绑定，组件不会改变它。
rotate.en-US: Image rotation angle in degrees. It is one-way: the component never changes it.

showResizeBox.zh-CN: 是否展示裁切框边角的调整块。
showResizeBox.en-US: Whether to show the resize handles on the corners of the crop box.

cropperBoxStyle.zh-CN: 裁切框样式，与组件计算的宽高和位移合并，宽高与位移以组件为准。
cropperBoxStyle.en-US: Style of the crop box, merged with the size and offset the component computes; the size and offset win.

cropperBoxCls.en-US: Class name of the crop box.

fill.zh-CN: 裁切结果中非图片部分的填充色。
fill.en-US: Fill color of the parts of the result that are not the image.

preview.zh-CN: 返回预览容器 DOM 的函数，裁切效果会实时镜像到该容器；可返回 `null`，表示容器尚未挂载。
preview.en-US: Function returning the DOM element of the preview container; the crop result is mirrored into it in real time. It may return `null` while the container is not mounted yet.

ref.zh-CN: 组件句柄，其上的 `getCropperCanvas` 方法用于获取裁切结果；它不是根元素。
ref.en-US: Handle exposing the `getCropperCanvas` method for reading the crop result; it is not the root element.

getCropperCanvas.zh-CN: 将裁切框内的区域按图片自身的分辨率绘制到新的 canvas 上。
getCropperCanvas.en-US: Draws the area inside the crop box, at the image's own resolution, onto a new canvas.
